verdict.rationale:
Docs show crypto/stablecoin features integrated via Stripe's standard REST-style integration ("Build crypto into your Stripe integration"), with settlement automatically converted to fiat in the Stripe balance and Stripe acting as merchant of record for onramp KYC/compliance — all signs that node/gas mechanics are abstracted away. However, the evidence never explicitly states blockchain nodes/gas are hidden, nor does it show crypto-specific client libraries in multiple languages (only general CLI/MCP probes are present).

missing for 10: explicit statement that gas fees/node operations are abstracted, explicit crypto-specific SDK/client library documentation, and independent confirmation of the abstraction working end-to-end.
